outcome: Prevention of COVID-19 transmission in the operating room
cohort: Six pregnant women with COVID-19 who underwent cesarean deliveries at Tongji Hospital in Wuhan, China, in January and February 2020
finding: This case series describes the perioperative management strategies implemented at a hospital in Wuhan, China, to prevent COVID-19 transmission during cesarean deliveries for pregnant women with COVID-19.
mod_finding: The abstract describes perioperative nursing strategies to prevent COVID-19 transmission during cesarean deliveries in pregnant women with COVID-19 but does not report on mode of delivery findings.
